system_config.scenario_scale: Toy projects and undergraduate-level applications (Exclude everything listed in inputs.out_of_scope and enterprise over-engineering)
system_config.technical_depth: Advanced CS undergraduate level (Focus on what inputs.focus_points lists)

task: Design the outline of an expository article that carries inputs.core_argument. The outline is a sequence of regions. form states which regions this article has, in which order and number, and what each one must say.
region_shape: role: The role of the region, copied from form.regions.
heading: A specific noun phrase naming what the region covers. It becomes the section heading.
key_sentence: Exactly one declarative sentence stating the region's point. The section will open with it.
elaboration: The explanation that supports the key sentence, written as the claims themselves and not as a plan of what to write.
example: One concrete example, scenario, or code path that makes the key sentence visible. An empty string when the role's example is false.
takeaway: A single English noun phrase of at most 10 words. An empty string when the role's focus is false.
constraints: output_language: Write every string value in English, except core_message, which is copied verbatim from inputs.core_argument.
core_message: Copy the exact string from inputs.core_argument 100% verbatim without any modification or translation.
form_id: Copy form.id into the form field of the output.

region_order: Output the regions in the order of form.regions. Write each role at least min and at most max times (max null means no upper limit), and keep regions of the same role next to each other.
region_guidance: Each region says what the guidance of its role in form.regions asks for, and nothing that belongs to another role.
focus_regions: Roles whose focus is true are the body of the article. Write exactly one focus region per item of inputs.focus_points, in the same order.
sentence_counts: Where a role gives sentences for a slot, write that slot with a number of sentences inside the given [min, max] range.
form_rules: Follow every item of form.rules.
no_first_person: Strictly forbid first-person anecdotes (e.g., 'When I built...').

no_instruction_terms: Use scenario_scale and technical_depth only to calibrate depth. Never write the project scale, audience level, or wording from these instructions (e.g., 'toy project', 'undergraduate', 'dilemma', 'key_sentence') into output text.
no_meta_commentary: Strictly forbid meta-statements explaining the purpose of the article (e.g., 'This article explores...', 'Let's take a look at...').

regions.description: The regions of the article in the order and number form.regions gives

heading.description: Specific noun phrase; becomes the section heading

elaboration.description: Supporting explanation, as the role's guidance asks

example.description: Concrete example; empty string when the role's example is false

takeaway.description: Noun phrase, max 10 words; empty string when the role's focus is false
